summary: Built context-reachability.sh, a standing source-store probe over the 591-file context corpus computing three non-short-circuiting reachability styles (filename, directory via every contiguous directory sub-range, and index via all 22 per-extension index-entries.json files) plus eager/lazy classification reused by invocation from measure-eager-context.sh. Proved it against a 39-file live regression property (present+founder template libraries), registered it in manifest.json and the utility-scripts inventory, documented directory-reference reachability in context-discovery.md, and closed the removal/merge/split decision gate with an empty confirmed-dead set via Reasoned Exclusions -- matching the research's own prediction exactly. verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow is identical to the Phase 1 baseline (35 checks, 0 failures). run-all.sh is 137 passed / 1 failed, the one failure a confirmed pre-existing load-sensitive timing flake in an unrelated file (task-lock.md's conflict-response ladder), not attributable to this task.
